name: zan-workflows
description: TAPD Bug repair and requirement development with scoped plans, task links, verified implementation and explicit delivery.

interface.shortDescription: TAPD Bug 修复与需求开发，按实际需要准备和交付。
interface.longDescription: Two main workflows for TAPD Bug repair and requirement development. Confirm a multi-project six-column checklist, implement with proportionate planning and independent review, then default to test-branch merge, test build and shared Wiki through an exact delivery plan. Explicit narrower requests override defaults; go-live requires an explicit request.
defaultPrompt: Use $fixing-bug for TAPD Bugs and $developing-requirement for Story/Task development. Load each capability only at its stage.

Prepare a concise scope, implementation and verification brief. Use formal Task/Plan capabilities only when actually needed or explicitly requested, preserving existing task readbacks and confirmed scope. Route approved Task creation through breaking-down-requirement to TAPD MCP create_task/create_tasks; checklists and Plans consume the same verified result.

Before initial writes, show 确定清单 with multi-project overview, a selected TAPD Task table (序号/标题/工时) before 执行内容, six columns, indexed notes and concrete writes. Prefix Task titles with the current operation 【新建】/【复用】/【调整】 and retain real links. Distinguish original/proposed Task estimates from evidence-based remaining work in the same hours cell; show only the Task list without totals, subtotals or missing-value counts. Keep unknowns explicit in their rows and list each Task once across projects. Display labels and remaining-work predictions never overwrite Task names or estimates or trigger scheduling. Use stable #F01 task references later; detail #01 and real Task/Plan identities stay separate. Ordinary repair/development defaults to test-branch merge, test build/deploy and shared Wiki, subject to explicit overrides and confirmation. Preview Wiki before confirmation. Approved content becomes 执行清单; material changes re-display the complete 确定清单. Preserve completed effects.

Use the original fixed branch for continued work. Bug implementation includes verified repair ownership and start/completion records. Ordinary full Bug repair first enters 修复中, then reaches 待测试 only after test-delivery gates pass. Show the final TAPD target under 合并与测试环境, distinguish planned targets from actual readbacks, and preserve existing implementation-only and idempotent continuation policies. Requirement implementation covers only selected Tasks and their acceptance.

Complete relevant verification and independent final review before default test delivery. Explicit implementation-only requests stop at REVIEWED. Merge/build means the verified dev/develop target and project test environment, subject to the exact delivery plan; go-live requires an explicit request.
Use submitting-for-test and going-live only for the requested delivery stage. Their exact write plans, readbacks, manual-merge handoff and separately confirmed cleanup remain authoritative.
